The best months to come

Raja Ampat is open all year. This is what the water does, seen from our own jetty.

  • BestOctober – FebruaryCalmest water, clearest visibility. Rooms fill early.
  • Still goodMarch – April, August – SeptemberMixed weather, but most days are fine on the water.
  • QuietMay – JulySoutheast wind, bigger swell. The emptiest months of the year.

What else we arrange

Getting here, getting around, getting on the water

Most of what a stay in Raja Ampat takes is not the bed. It is the boat, the ride from the ferry, and somebody who knows where the fish are. The family arranges all of it, and you ask for it the same way you ask for a house.

Snorkelling trip

Out past the jetty by boat, to the reefs a swim will not reach. How far you get depends on the tide that morning, so tell us what you would like to see and we will say what works.

The prices shown are the ones that hold. Getting here

How you reach us

Raja Ampat is a long way off, but the way in is a straight line, and the last part of it is us.

  1. By air1

    Land at Sorong

    Domine Eduard Osok airport, SOQ. Daily flights from Jakarta, Makassar and Manado.

  2. By sea2

    Ferry to Waisai

    The fast ferry leaves Sorong harbour twice a day, morning and early afternoon, and takes about two hours.

  3. In Waisai3

    The entry fees

    Raja Ampat charges a marine park fee and a visitor ticket, both settled in Waisai at the jetty. The park card lasts a year. Ask us and we will tell you what they come to this season.

  4. The last hour4

    We meet you at Falaya

    Our boat waits at Dermaga Falaya in Waisai and takes you across to the house at Yenbuba, on Pulau Mansuar.

Ferry times move and boats do not always keep to them. Send us the one you are on and we will be at Falaya when it arrives.

Questions

Things people ask before they come

How do we get to Yenbuba?+

Fly to Sorong, take the ferry to Waisai on Waigeo, and we pick you up there by boat. Tell us your ferry time and we will be at the harbour.

Is there electricity and signal?+

Electricity runs in the evening. Phone signal reaches the village, and there is Wi-Fi at the house when the connection holds.

Can we snorkel from the homestay?+

Yes, straight off the jetty. Fins and masks are at the house; bring your own if you prefer a good fit.

Do you take card?+

Cash in rupiah, or a bank transfer before you arrive. There is no card machine in the village.
